reasoning.observation: The prospectively frozen NETH25 breakout-fade C032 admitted 11 trades and failed gross edge before costs. It supplies no warrant to retune C032, rerun its outer, close the entire family or narrow the open 1578-symbol frontier.
reasoning.information_gain_rationale: A new narrow economic identity would consume scarce budget with unresolved breadth, opportunity density and transaction-local feasibility. The accepted broker-native metadata and 40-symbol M5 structural evidence permit a non-economic, cross-family availability audit first. Historical C006/C012 survivors are relevant hypothesis sources, not evidence that their exact identities transfer to new symbols.
reasoning.selected_action: Run a deterministic, candidate-independent information-gain and realizability audit on existing authenticated evidence. Compare open mechanism families by causal observation coverage, potential event density, EUR200 feasibility, trading-session overlap and missing transaction-local cost authority. Rank minimal next authenticated data prerequisites without interpreting a new outer or selecting an economic identity from its own result.
reasoning.scope: Retain all 1578 eligible post-exclusion frontier candidates; use the 40 accepted M5 series as a structural sampling surface, not an economically equivalent universe.
reasoning.data_policy: Reuse hash-bound accepted evidence. Any proposed additional broker capture must be frozen read-only and minimal before collection.
reasoning.decision_boundary: If existing evidence cannot establish broker-native cost/entry availability for a leading independent mechanism, prepare a prospective minimal data-capture plan. Do not authorize a new economic outcome until prospective identity, causal data, margin and costs are resolved and exact-head green.
